name: polylog
description: One git log across every repo in your workspace. Search commits by message across all of them at once, and see the changed files without switching repositories.

polylog.pageSize.description: Commits fetched per repository per page.

polylog.maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of git processes running at once.

polylog.scanDepth.markdownDescription: Folder levels to search for repositories when the Git extension reports none. See also `#git.repositoryScanMaxDepth#`.

polylog.excludeRepos.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out, matched against the repository folder name and its full path.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check:denylist && npm run bundle
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/denylist.test.mjs && esbuild src/gitLog.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/gitLog.test.cjs && node out/gitLog.test.cjs && esbuild src/filterModel.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/filterModel.test.cjs && node out/filterModel.test.cjs && esbuild src/mergeStream.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/mergeStream.test.cjs && node out/mergeStream.test.cjs && esbuild src/revisionUri.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/revisionUri.test.cjs && node out/revisionUri.test.cjs && esbuild src/commitDetail.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/commitDetail.test.cjs && node out/commitDetail.test.cjs
